LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_Repaired: Second Shoot repaired {0} plant hit points.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_CareHelp: {0} will tend this crop for 2 seconds, repairing up to {1} hit points. Interrupted work keeps the care record. Sowing a new seedling replaces the previous membrane and any unused care record.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_Protected: Nursery Watch: one hit, up to {0} damage. Sower: {1}.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_NoRepair: Membrane spent; this crop needs no repair. Sower: {0}.

LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_Inactive: Inactive: Outside the area or its source is unavailable.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_ShelteredRepair: Sheltered Row repaired {0} hit points on a second crop.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_ShelterReady: Sheltered Row: One record ready. Effective tending can also repair the nearest other damaged sown crop within 2 cells on a colony home map, up to 2 hit points. Without an eligible second crop, the record is kept.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_WatchReady: Keeping Watch: {0} can restore this membrane once by absorbing enemy damage within 4 cells, using shields from another source. Available for half a day after tending.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_TransferHelp: {0} can move this unused membrane once to another sown seedling within 8 cells on this colony home map, up to 10% grown. The original budget and expiry remain. This option expires one hour after the care that earned it.

LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_ReturnHelp: {0} will work for 2 seconds to repair up to 4 hit points on this original crop. The opportunity lasts one hour after the water-funded sowing. Interrupted work keeps the record; successful repair cannot create more water.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_ReturnRepair: Return Flow repaired {0} plant hit points.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_ReturnReady: Return Flow: {0} may repair this original crop within one hour of the water-funded sowing.
LanguageData.RHA_StarNursery030_WaterHeld: Water Catcher: {0} holds one water record for the next completed sowing on this map, valid for one hour after collection.
